text:
morgan: Morning — async standup. Quick one:
- Yesterday: finished the audit mappings for svc-graph and ran the dry-run for KMS rotations against staging. Found one role mismatch in the automation lambda.
- Blockers: the rotation dry-run fails with AccessDenied when the lambda invokes `kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion` on the staging key. I suspect an IAM role policy not including `kms:TagResource`.
- Today: patch the lambda role, re-run dry-run, and open a short PR for the audit docs. Will ping infra for the role change.

zahra: Thanks — can you paste the error snippet? I can take a look if you're AFK later.

morgan: error from logs: `2024-05-01T09:12:03Z ERROR KMS-DRYRUN - AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/automation-lambda-role is not authorized to perform: kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111111111111:key/abcd-ef01`

lee: Heads up — snyk-bot flagged a new high on `grpc-tools` in the helper util yesterday, might be unrelated but worth triaging before the PR. @snyk-bot any reference? :eyes:

snyk-bot: SNYK-2024-GRPC-001: grpc-tools@1.10.0 — prototype pollution — introduced via devDeps. Low/no runtime exposure for production images but flagged in repo `infra/ops-scripts`. Link: https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-2024-GRPC-001

samir: For the IAM issue: when you ran the dry-run, was the role assumed via STS from a cross-account step? I'm wondering if there's a conditions mismatch on `kms:ViaService` in the policy.

morgan: yes — automation lambda is in account A and calls KMS in account B via cross-account role. Policy currently allows `kms:*` but has `Condition: {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "ec2.amazonaws.com"}}` which is wrong. I missed that when copying policy templates. Going to remove the ViaService condition and add explicit `kms:TagResource` and `kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion`.

zahra: Nice catch. If you want I can push the role change to staging so you can re-run — I have rights.

morgan: that would be great — thanks. Once patched I'll re-run and then create a short PR with the policy diff and the test output.

engsec-oncall: FYI — putting a note in the oncall doc to expect a short KMS maintenance window in staging around 11:30 UTC while we validate. No effect on prod.

lee: small ask — can we include a short checklist in the PR template for KMS rotations: permissions, cross-account trust, key alias update, and rollback steps? We keep forgetting key alias TTL.

morgan: agreed, adding a checklist item. Will tag @samir for review on the trust policy changes.

samir: Happy to review after you push. If you want me to pre-sign a quick policy diff I can drop it in the PR comments.

morgan: awesome—will ping when PR is up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
